title: CW - Cosmetic Waypoints
description: blocks with something glowing to act as a cosmetic vanilla waypoint
body:
# Cosmetic Waypoints!
I always wanted some sort of cosmetic waypoint that would show up whenever u got close so i made it happen!

**2.0+! [ColoredNameTeams](https://modrinth.com/project/GozyTkF6) Required for recolouring blocks**

This is a continuation of my MarkerBlocks pack and its succesor

Q: How do i craft the waypoints?
A: Simply add a Glow Ink Sac and a Glass Block to a crafting grid!

Q: I think i found a bug what do i do?
A: Please reach out to me on discord!

~~Q: Will there be any changes in the future?~~
~~A: Yes! i plan on making the glowing effect a whole block if possible and then making that a sort of B version that will be available with the A version too.~~
